source: Official scheme and regulation pages behind the sustainability checklist items
notes: Each URL was checked on 2026-10-24 with a HEAD (then GET) request from the build environment; status 'verified' means the page answered HTTP 200 that day.

Official pages that block automated requests or did not connect stay 'unverified' - the framework itself is real and named in the checklist, but the link needs a manual check before quoting it to judges. No URL was added without an attempt.

Consent to Operate and hazardous-waste authorisation are issued by each State Pollution Control Board under the Water Act 1974 / Air Act 1981 and the Hazardous Waste Rules 2016; there is no single national portal, so the CPCB umbrella site is cited for them.

refs.name: MSME ZED Certification (Zero Defect Zero Effect)
refs.what: Ministry of MSME certification scheme rated Bronze, Silver, Gold (and higher) on environmental and quality practice; subsidised for MSMEs.

refs.name: ISO 14001 environmental management systems
refs.what: The ISO 14001:2015 standard page: requirements for an environmental management system.
refs.note: iso.org returned HTTP 403 to automated requests (bot blocking); the page is the official ISO 14001:2015 entry, check manually in a browser.

refs.name: Consent to Operate (State Pollution Control Boards / CPCB)
refs.what: CPCB umbrella site; each State Pollution Control Board issues Consent to Establish and Consent to Operate under the Water Act 1974 and Air Act 1981.
refs.note: cpcb.nic.in did not connect from the build environment (connection failed, likely network-level blocking of the host); verify manually.

refs.name: EPR for plastic packaging (CPCB portal)
refs.what: Extended Producer Responsibility registration portal for plastic packaging under the Plastic Waste Management Rules 2016 (as amended 2021-22).
refs.note: eprplastic.cpcb.gov.in did not connect from the build environment (connection failed); verify manually.

refs.name: Hazardous-waste authorisation (Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules 2016)
refs.what: CPCB page for the Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016, under which SPCBs grant authorisation to handlers.
refs.note: cpcb.nic.in did not connect from the build environment (connection failed); verify manually.

refs.name: SIDBI energy-efficiency finance for MSMEs
refs.what: SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) main site; it runs concessional loan lines for MSME energy-efficiency and cleaner-production upgrades.
refs.note: Root URL redirects to https://www.sidbi.in/en/ and returned HTTP 200; the specific scheme page was not pinned down, so the bank's site is cited.
